first_light.title: First Light
first_light.subtitle: You stayed. Fifty years from now, you will send these letters back.

morning_ferry.title: The Morning Ferry
morning_ferry.subtitle: You rode the 6:10 into the first sunrise Hushwater had seen in seventeen years.

long_dusk.title: The Long Dusk
long_dusk.subtitle: The sun did not rise. Not this time. The letters will come again.
